visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A man with a long yellow wig and a blue-and-white patterned sweater stands in a green park, holding a smartphone and pointing upwards with an excited facial expression. (2) Cut to another man in a white T-shirt and a black baseball cap, holding a phone horizontally as if playing a game; a large Mickey Mouse statue is visible in the background. (3) The man in the yellow wig holds up a golden collectible trading card featuring a dragon illustration. (4) The man in the white shirt, now wearing a white hard hat and carrying a large shovel over his shoulder, walks through a paved park area. (5) The man in the hard hat is shown digging in the soil beneath a large tree, looking exhausted with a strained facial expression. (6) The man in the sweater reappears, now wearing oversized orange fox ears and a matching tail, standing with his arms crossed and a smug expression. (7) Close-up shots show the fox-eared character speaking aggressively, followed by a dark scene of a forest path illuminated by a flashlight at night. (8) A man with grey hair and a fake mustache holds a small whiteboard with handwritten Chinese text, pointing a marker at it while lecturing. (9) A student in a white school uniform sits at a desk, looking bored with his chin resting on his hand. (10) The student walks through a playground and is stopped by a man wearing a neon yellow police vest and a blue cap. (11) The student hands over a document to the policeman and then stands proudly with his lower body pixelated/censored. (12) A man wearing a red-and-black jester mask and costume speaks directly to the camera against a blurred green background. (13) Graphic overlays appear with a list of five 'Don't' icons and text, followed by a series of stylized illustrations depicting various monsters and demons. (14) The man from the first scene (without a wig) appears in a denim jacket against a dark, moody studio background, making hand gestures toward the viewer.

visual_human_presence.countingEvidence: One main male actor playing multiple distinct characters throughout various sketches.
visual_human_presence.mainCharacterDescription: A male creator appearing in various costumes: a yellow wig with a blue sweater, a white hard hat with a vest, a fox-eared creature, a teacher with a fake mustache, and a student.

visual_scene_and_style.backgroundDescribe: Shifts between a lush green park with trees, a paved outdoor area with a Mickey Mouse statue, a simple white classroom wall, a forest path at night, and a dark studio room.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) High-arousal male voice speaks rapidly with an excited tone; low-level outdoor ambient noise present. (2) A sharp 'whoosh' transition SFX triggers a shift to a more skeptical, lower-pitched male voice. (3) Ominous synthesizer drone rises in volume as the character reveals a 'monster' identity; vocal tone becomes deeper and more authoritative. (4) Transition to a news-style broadcast sound with lo-fi filtering and a serious narrative tone. (5) Fast-paced comedic BGM starts with a strong electronic beat; a loud, projected male voice delivers a lecture with high intensity. (6) A 'bubble' pop SFX marks a scene change to a casual conversational tone in a playground setting. (7) Uplifting, corporate-style orchestral BGM swells as a professional narrator voice provides clear, enunciated information about the Taiwan Stock Exchange. (8) Sound effects like 'ding' and 'impact' hits emphasize key graphic points on screen.

narrative_and_purpose.narrativeStructure: Montage: Hook -> Series of Sketches -> Educational PSA -> Summary Call-to-Action
narrative_and_purpose.mainPurpose: To educate the public about various types of investment scams (personified as 'ghosts' or 'monsters') through a series of comedic sketches, sponsored by the Taiwan Stock Exchange.

endorsement_analysis.endorsementCues: Direct display of the Taiwan Stock Exchange logo and a detailed PSA section discussing their anti-fraud initiative.

high_inference.freeDescribe: The video uses a high-density editing style typical of social media influencers to convey a government/institutional anti-fraud message in an engaging way.
